snippet.title: How to Fix the Future: Book One | Trailer
snippet.description:
How to Fix the Future is a gripping, story-driven sci-fi visual novel. Spanning the present and near future, this tale weaves together mystery, romance, and high-stakes adventure, where every choice crafts a unique path through a world on the brink of transformation.
